summary: A Quote during the closing auction: the quote fields as usual; the web also publishes the indicative equilibrium price, reference price, equilibrium and imbalance quantities and the auction flag.

deviations.reason: The web's Upstox LTP payload names the previous close cp; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).
